experiment: Three-way randomized paired graph, dirty-bucket, and full-scan propagation

protocol.armOrders: all six permutations balanced eight times, then shuffled across 48 paired blocks
protocol.inputAccounting: all paths update the same changed source IDs and values
protocol.host: Float64Array; same output values and number of host writes
protocol.setup: graph construction and dirty-structure allocation excluded from timed updates
protocol.outputParity: all host outputs compared across all three paths after every scenario
protocol.caveat: one-edge-per-entity scalar topology; 64-entity bucket size; no DOM or React work
